title: The Shopping List
subtitle: The condition is on the task, not the reward
description: The checkmark below would normally complete on any press. The condition
beside it says otherwise: eight cobblestone have to be in the player's
inventory before the submit counts, and the server checks that at the
press as well as in its own tick.
The condition is measured and never taken -- a condition never consumes
anything, because it only ever answers a question.
The reward is where the story continues: it grants the stage
`condition_gallery:password`, which is the flag the next quest asks for.
